create_google_genai_backend: create a GoogleGenAIAPI backend instance configured for text generation with Vertex AI
run_generate_text: run generate_text on the GoogleGenAIAPI backend with a string prompt and temperature parameter
run_generate_object: run generate_object on the GoogleGenAIAPI backend to produce a structured Pydantic model from a prompt
run_chat: run chat on the GoogleGenAIAPI backend with a sequence of messages and API formatter
run_embed: run embed on the GoogleGenAIAPI backend to compute vector embeddings for a text string
run_tokenize: run tokenize on the GoogleGenAIAPI backend to get token IDs for a text string
run_count_tokens: run count_tokens on the GoogleGenAIAPI backend to count tokens in a text string
register_backend: register the GoogleGenAIAPI backend to expose generate_text, chat, embed, tokenize, and count_tokens functions
